title: The Burnt Extraction
author: Cyrus Vasquez
blurb: Gideon Joubert, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
